title: 第十七章 伤痕第十八章 异火下落
content_zh:
“有了炼药师这个身份，以后办事就方便多了。眼下炼体药材消耗殆尽，我要想在半年之后战胜楚玥，还得将灵脉数量提上来。”楚天舒心中盘算道，“前世我收集的秘术中恰有一种逆天改命之法，能改造出后天灵脉！只不过此法需要一名‘血族’，实在难办。”
血族，沧澜大陆北部最古老的种族之一，有着神鬼莫测、匪夷所思之能！滴血重生、肉体改造、寿比齐天，高阶血族那几乎是不死的存在！普通血族寿命长达千年！
这一族是实实在在的北域霸主，统治北域几十万年，没有任何种族能够撼动。
楚天舒前世率军扩张北域，就快将血族推平时，一位老怪物苏醒，与他大战一场，两人虽战成平手，但那位老怪物的话倒是让他起了个寒颤：“若非到了关键时期，我早就燃烧生命极尽升华，将你轰得渣都不剩！”
之后，魔主与血族达成和平协议，退兵东域，不再进犯。
现在想来也是有些心惊，上古时期的老怪物，自生命诞生起就长存于世，其全盛时期的修为或许已是神级存在。
正当楚天舒思考之际，远处传来的争执之声吸引了他的注意力。
“秦掌柜，不是说好了两块生灵石吗？怎么又涨到三块了？”
“这养胃丹如此珍贵，即使受潮损失了一些药效，那也是实实在在的一品丹药啊，贵些怎么了？不行的话你也可以不买呀。”
“楚毅？”楚天舒认出了其中一人，那正是被他洗劫还苦苦抵抗的楚毅。
在秦家药店前，老掌柜正在刁难他。
“我……我只有两块生灵石，剩下一块可否先欠着。”楚毅压着怒火，卑微道。
“行啊，不过下次要带两块生灵石来，否则你以后就别想在我这买到养胃丹了。”老掌柜笑道，那小眼睛里满是贪婪。
还要再加一块生灵石！
楚毅肉疼着答应了下来：“好。”
一旁楚天舒冷眼旁观，正准备绕道而行，结果无意间瞥了一眼，这一眼令他停下脚步：“嗯？那个伤疤是……焰痕？”
只见楚毅右手边上一条蜈蚣似的伤痕爬上右臂，疤痕周围染上了一层淡青色。
“只有被异火焚烧过才会产生这样的伤口。”楚天舒一眼就认出了这伤口的来源。
异火！
他被异火焚烧过！

“以我现在的境界，若是有了异火，炼出三品丹药不在话下，凭借着丹药辅助，我的修炼速度定然会倍增。”楚天舒有了想法，“正好缺小弟帮我打杂，就他了。”
楚毅从怀中取出仅有的两块生灵石，正准备递给老掌柜，这时一个突兀的声音传来：“我用这枚丹药帮他付。”
一个不知从何处飞来的木盒突然落在了桌面上，盒内一枚一品丹药散发着浓郁的药香。
老掌柜眼疾手快，飞一般地将楚天舒的丹药收入储物袋中。脸上顿时挤出了笑容：“好！成交！公子大气。”
楚毅猛地扭头，身后楚天舒嘴角勾起一抹微笑，静静地望着他……
content_en:
"With the identity of an alchemist, it will be much easier to do things in the future. Now that the body refining medicines are exhausted, if I want to defeat Chu Yue in half a year, I have to increase the number of spiritual veins." Chu Tianshu thought in his mind, "Among the secret techniques I collected in my previous life, there is a method that defies fate and can transform the acquired spiritual veins! However, this method requires a 'blood clan', which is really difficult to do."
The Vampire Tribe, one of the oldest races in the northern part of the Canglan Continent, has unpredictable and incredible abilities! Rebirth with blood, body transformation, and longevity, the high-level Vampires are almost immortal! The lifespan of an ordinary vampire can be as long as a thousand years!
This clan is the real overlord of the Northern Territory. They have ruled the Northern Territory for hundreds of thousands of years, and no other race can shake them.
In his previous life, Chu Tianshu led his army to expand the Northern Territory and was about to level the vampire clan. An old monster woke up and fought a battle with him. Although the two of them were tied, the old monster's words made him shudder: "If it hadn't been for a critical period, I would have burned my life to the utmost to sublimate you and blasted you to nothing!"
After that, the Demon Lord and the Blood Tribe reached a peace agreement, retreated from the Eastern Region, and stopped invading.
Now that I think about it, I am a little scared. The old monster from ancient times has existed in the world since the birth of life. Its cultivation in its heyday may have been a god-level existence.
While Chu Tianshu was thinking, the sound of arguments in the distance attracted his attention.
"Shopkeeper Qin, didn't you agree on two living stones? Why did it increase to three?"
"This stomach nourishing elixir is so precious. Even if it loses some of its efficacy due to moisture, it is still a real first-class elixir. What's wrong with it being more expensive? If it doesn't work, you don't have to buy it."
"Chu Yi?" Chu Tianshu recognized one of them. It was Chu Yi who was being robbed by him and still resisting.
In front of Qin's pharmacy, the old shopkeeper was making things difficult for him.
"I...I only have two living stones. Can I owe the remaining one first?" Chu Yi said humbly, suppressing his anger.
"Okay, but you have to bring two living stones next time, otherwise you won't be able to buy stomach nourishing pills from me in the future." The old shopkeeper smiled, his little eyes full of greed.
Also add another living stone!
Chu Yi's body ached and he agreed: "Okay."
Chu Tianshu looked on with cold eyes and was about to take a detour when he accidentally glanced at him. This glance made him stop: "Huh? Is that scar...a flame mark?"
I saw a centipede-like scar on Chu Yi's right hand climbing up his right arm, and the scar was stained with a layer of light blue.
"Only being burned by strange fire can such a wound occur." Chu Tianshu recognized the source of the wound at a glance.
Strange fire!
He was burned by strange fire!
"With my current level, if I have a strange fire, I can easily refine third-grade elixirs. With the aid of elixirs, my cultivation speed will definitely double." Chu Tianshu had an idea, "I just need a younger brother to help me with odd jobs, so he is the only one."
Chu Yi took out the only two living stones from his arms and was about to hand them to the old shopkeeper when a sudden voice came: "I will use this pill to help him pay."
A wooden box that flew out of nowhere suddenly landed on the table. A first-grade elixir inside the box exuded a strong medicinal fragrance.
The old shopkeeper had quick eyes and quick hands and quickly put Chu Tianshu's elixir into the storage bag. A smile suddenly appeared on his face: "Okay! Deal! Young Master is grand."
Chu Yi turned his head suddenly, and behind him, Chu Tianshu raised a smile on his lips and looked at him quietly...
